paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.46% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.46%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-2.12%). Brent crude changed -1.15% to 113.56. Gold changed -1.08% to 3,988.0. Bitcoin changed -0.23% to 77,599.9922. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.989%, a relative move of -1.11%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (+4.50%) and Deutsche Bank (+4.03%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Evonik rejects BASF’s sweetened €11bn takeover bid (FT Companies). Speciality chemicals company leaves door open to ‘informational exchange’ as larger rival seeks to create Germany-based industrial champion Deals and capital markets: Private equity firm swoops on China Evergrande unit in rare win for creditors (FT World). Hong Kong-based PAG offers $513mn to liquidators recovering assets from world’s most indebted property developer Central banks and macro: Bank of Japan says 2% inflation goal reached after decades of deflation (FT World).
